text: wp_draft.py --reimage is a one-shot state change: a second --reimage uploads ANOTHER media and REMOVES the just-attached one while featured_media still points at the deleted id (observed 2026-11-23, wellroost post 468: media 470 deleted after 471 uploaded). Verify a reimage by REST read-back of featured_media, never by re-running the command; repair a broken pointer with a direct REST PATCH. Same incident: the director's alt text arrived truncated mid-phrase on the media object while the sidecar held the full sentence — repair alt/caption in featured.json first, then REST PATCH the media and the Supabase metadata so artifact, row, media and reader page take one string.
